name: Stat
description: A key number with its label and context: a value, an optional change over time and an optional small trend graphic. Unframed: place it in a Card or a grid.

label.description: What the number measures, e.g. "Monthly revenue".

value.description: The number. A number is formatted with toLocaleString unless format is given; a string is shown as is.

format.description: Formats a numeric value, e.g. as currency.

unit.description: A small unit after the value, such as % or /mo.

trend.description: The change over time. change is signed; label says what it is compared with ("vs last month"); goodWhen says which direction is an improvement (default up).

data.description: Recent values, drawn as a small Sparkline beside the value.

description.description: A short line of extra context under the value.

isLoading.description: Shows placeholder blocks and announces loading.

requirements: The whole stat reads as one sentence, e.g. "Monthly revenue: $48,200. Up 12% compared with last month."
Direction is always said in words (Up, Down, No change) and shown with an arrow shape, never by color alone
Good or bad is only spoken when goodWhen is set explicitly; the tint is an extra cue
Pill text uses the default text color on a subtle tint, meeting 4.5:1 in light and dark mode
While loading the region is marked busy and says Loading
Not interactive: it is not focusable
screenReader: Read in place as one sentence: label, value, change and description
Loading reads "Loading" followed by the label

use_when: Dashboards and summaries that lead with a few key numbers
Showing a number with how it changed
avoid_when: Many numbers that need comparing: use a Table
A value that changes live and must be announced: use a live region
anti_patterns: Showing a change as only a green or red color
Putting more than a handful of stats in one row
